title: Board model
description: Components, pins and nets of one board from one netlist source plus an optional BOM. Written by python -m boardreview prep, which calls python -m boardreview.model build. Scripts produce it; reviewers read it.

sources.description: Files the model was built from, in load order.

pin_list_complete.description: True when pins with no net are listed (IPC-D-356, KiCad, eda-agent). False for Protel .NET, which omits them, so open-pin checks cannot run.

value.description: Value text as found (10k, 100nF, 120R@100MHz). attrs.value_from says where it came from.

value_si.description: Value in SI units (ohm, F, H; ferrite beads in ohm at 100 MHz), null when unknown.

fitted.description: False for DNP / Not Fitted in the BOM, netlist or chosen variant.

number.description: Pin or pad number as the source writes it (1, A12, SHLD).

name.description: Pin name when the source has it (KiCad, eda-agent), else empty.

type.description: Electrical type when known: passive, input, output, bidirectional, tri_state, power_in, power_out, open_collector, open_emitter, no_connect, unspecified, free.

net.description: Net name; null when the pin has no net (N/C, unconnected, tool-named single-pin net).

no_connect.description: True when the source marks the pin as deliberately not connected.

class.description: Net class from the source when it carries one, else empty.

kind.description: From the name only. power_tree.md adds rails found by structure.

auto_named.description: True when the CAD tool generated the name (NetC5_2, Net-(R1-Pad2)).

attrs.description: Extra facts, for example vias (count of via records in an IPC-D-356 file).
